entities.name: Adopt reference methods by class behind project boundaries
entities.summary: Pilot methods are adopted as-is, adapted behind project-owned boundaries, or deferred as design constraints; never imported as code or authority.

entities.name: RX1: cross-runtime generator determinism
entities.summary: Byte-compare canonical project views across repeated Bun and genuine Node runs; inventory or kill on divergence.

acceptance: Bun and genuine Node produce byte-identical ten-view trees from the same canonical sources
Three clean repeated runs produce identical view digests
Divergence sources are inventoried, or the kill criterion is recorded

observation.not_established: Future determinism, result-identity backdating correctness, or memoization correctness.

evidence.claim: RX1 is complete for the current project-model output boundary; future determinism and memoization correctness remain unestablished.
Three Bun and three genuine Node runtime trials, each with separate validation and generation processes, emitted byte-identical ten-view trees and CLI streams.

entities.name: RX2: assumptions(artifact) over recorded edges
entities.summary: Derive per-artifact assumption reports from canonical relations with a seeded-stub positive fixture and a permanent opaque-adapter negative fixture.

acceptance: Seeded stub assumption surfaces through at least three intermediate derivations
Opaque-adapter negative fixture demonstrates the silent-partial report and is linked from the opaque-primitive register
Two-day wiring cap respected or the kill recorded

entities.name: Staged model-routed reference research
entities.summary: A staged, model-routed workflow produced auditable evidence packets; current adoption decisions are separately re-derived against repository boundaries.

attributes.not_established: Correctness or suitability of any external method; custody-complete provenance; paper-body verification; independent acceptance of the integrated portfolio.

entities.name: Integrated reference-baselines portfolio artifacts
entities.summary: Current boundary-mapped portfolio, ladder, and experiments reuse the immutable 17-card cached packet and add the verified six-card refinement packet without upgrading their evidence.

attributes.provenance_limits: Only 5 of 23 catalog sources are custody-locked; refinement cards preserve their own unresolved source and license fields.

relations.summary: Research assertion with recorded provenance; not proof.
RX2 and later experiments rest on the determinism precondition RX1 probes.
